planning_notes: Board is Arduino Uno with authoritative pins: D13=LED output, D9=PWM output, D6=buzzer tone output, D2=button input.
Serial baud is 9600 with framing line_or_idle and idle_timeout_ms=20 as provided.

Button wiring polarity is assumed active-high with pullup enabled (i.e., button press makes D2 go HIGH). If the real circuit is wired active-low, the SysML model must flip the logical interpretation; no extra hardware polarity inversion is applied here.
PWM scaling uses catalog numeric space 0..255 via scale=255 and offset=0, matching the typical Uno analogWrite duty range; SysML should map the received PWM:<value> command into this range.

STATUS reporting format is assumed to be typed numeric/Boolean fields serialized by the runtime as part of the existing serial status protocol; since the exact textual format is unspecified, labels LED/PWM/BUZZ are provided as report value descriptors only.
Button press triggers STATUS reporting together with the STATUS command, per requirement; the exact edge vs level behavior and debouncing belong in the SysML model (not in port definitions).
Unspecified business behavior for BLINK, ON, OFF, BUZZ (including blink period and buzzer duration) is not placed into device requests; it must be implemented in the SysML model using elapsed_ms.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: LED D13 state controlled by serial commands and used for STATUS reporting

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: PWM LED D9 duty/level controlled by serial commands (PWM:<value>) and used for STATUS reporting

interfaces.name: io_2
interfaces.meaning: Buzzer output frequency controlled by serial commands (BUZZ) and stopped by OFF

interfaces.name: io_3
interfaces.meaning: Button input; when pressed, system outputs current LED state and PWM value over Serial

interfaces.name: serial_0_trigger
interfaces.meaning: Report STATUS when a STATUS serial command is received, and also when the button is pressed

interfaces.name: serial_0_value_0
interfaces.meaning: Reported LED state (D13 logical ON/OFF) at time of report

interfaces.name: serial_0_value_1
interfaces.meaning: Reported PWM value commanded to D9 at time of report (model value in 0..255)

interfaces.name: serial_0_value_2
interfaces.meaning: Reported buzzer frequency currently active (0 if silent) at time of report

configuration_resolution.original_requirement: 构建一个串口命令控制的综合执行系统，使用 LED D13、PWM LED D9、蜂鸣器 D6 和按钮 D2。系统支持串口命令 ON、OFF、BLINK、PWM:数值、BUZZ 和 STATUS；按钮按下时通过串口输出当前 LED 状态和 PWM 值。
